Why I canceled after 3 deliveries. The food arrived too warm, and it’s not summer yet. I’m guessing those black bags won’t do well in the summer sun.

The only thing I liked about Cook Unity was the biodegradable trays, rather than plastic, and the idea of no packing waste, though it turned out that resulted in meals arriving with melted ice packs.

Notmfor everyone (not for me). I'm going to call myself a 'picky eater'. I don't have any so-called food 'allergies', there are just things I never ate and never will. Among them are seafood, most beef (except a hamburger once a year or so), and when it comes to cuisines, I can't stomach Indian or anything spicy. I'm neither a West Coast person nor someone who ever found Mexican food even slightly appealing.

Some people have said this makes me 'difficult' to find food I'll eat, while others understand immediately, I'll eat Italian, and I love Chinese (even Thai). Sometimes I'll enjoy a chicken Kyiv or a beef Wellington, but I tend to stay away from meat (although I spent a decade eating at restaurants without realizing the 'chicken' dishes I loved were all soy. Wow!).

I scrolled through this because I really wanted to try it. I won't touch empanadas or quesadillas I don’t want or like any of those.

When I go out, K never has a problem. I'm not overweight - far from it but I do eat. I like a good lasagna, a quiche, an omelette, or pasta. This other stuff just turns me off.

I'll stick to calling my Empire Szechuan, or the goodmitalian place close by.

I personally cannot handle too much spice and have accidentally ordered or the auto selector picked a few that had a kick to them that are too much for me. If something like that could get added then this app would be 5 stars for me.(If there is already a way to do this please let me know).

reviews.text:
Cook Unity is the bomb!. Not only do I have delicious food to eat from a different chef around the world at my fingertips, but I’ve actually lost a ton of weight because the food I am eating is so healthy! I concentrate on ordering the meals that are high in protein and low in fat. All of the ingredients are spelled right out, so you can work around dietary restrictions (like I am allergic to dairy). 

When you set up your profile, you highlight your favorite meats, fish, vegetables, etc. If you don’t have time to make selections one week, they will fill your basket with great, new, delicious ideas… Perhaps my favorite thing of all is - none of the meals I have ordered take more than a couple of minutes to prepare! 

The meals come fresh, not frozen, they go right in your refrigerator and you can cook them either in your oven or microwave. For someone who is on the go, go, go, this has been a game-changer!!! We are eating much healthier. We don’t eat Cook Unity every night, but on those nights we don’t feel like big meal prep - this is our go-to. I cannot say enough good things about Cook Unity!

The ingredients are fresh, veggies are crisp not mushy. The chicken is never overcooked, the salmon portions are generous and moist, pasta is perfectly al dente. I’ve only had 1 meal I didn’t enjoy and it was a flavor issue not a failing in process or product. Week after week the quality is perfect and the delivery is reliable. I also appreciate the reusable packaging so nothing goes to waste, no big cardboard boxes or packing material to throw out. Delivery is always on time (except one time it was an hour late). I’ve been impressed with every meal and the price is great! I highly recommend CookUnity! You won’t be disappointed!
